newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Borsodchem confident of 100pct tax relief.
newsitem.headline: Borsodchem confident of 100pct tax relief.

text.p: Hungarian chemicals company Borsodchem Rt said it has fulfilled legal requirements for a corporate tax break, the company's CEO told Reuters on Wednesday.

"The company will be entitled to claim back corporate tax on its entire production at its Kazinczbarcika base which amounts to 98 percent of production," said Borsodchem General Director Laszlo Kovacs.

He added that if a company made a productive investment of over one billion forints in 1996 and will increase its exports by an annual five percent over the next five years, it is entitled to reclaim tax.

"We did that investment and we will easily surpass the five percent export growth requirement," Kovacs said, adding that this year's five percent export increase would mean some 52 million forints for Borsodchem while the company plans to boost exports by "several hundred million" forints.
He said when planning their 1996 investments, they had taken into account tax legislation.
